summary: Mobile/touch support is in branch 'mobile' (worktree /home/user/BLIND-SPOT/.claude/worktrees/mobile), 7 checkpoint commits after c4201ab; last is 9e9e672. Tree is clean and dist/ is back to the base version. Three new modules: src/core/input.js (InputMode: works out whether the player is on touch or mouse/keyboard, switches on real input for hybrid devices, sets html.bs-touch, emits 'input:mode'), src/core/quality.js (mobile quality preset, desktop gets nothing), src/systems/TouchControls.js (look by drag, floating joystick, tap to interact, inspect gestures, pause button, fullscreen + landscape lock, wider FOV in portrait, browser hygiene; all touch CSS lives under html.bs-touch). Small additive hooks were added to PlayerController, Interaction, InspectView, UI, resolution.js, main.js and index.html, plus ONE new SCRIPT.touch block at the end of SCRIPT. Every priority (1-6) was seen working in screenshots, portrait and landscape. Desktop is unchanged: smoke-test passes on all 6 states. A desktop A/B against the c4201ab build gives identical config (FOV 70, pixel-ratio cap 1.5, PCFSoft shadows, feeds 640x480 with 4x MSAA, composer MSAA 2, prompt key 'E', prompt not clickable, no touch UI visible) and an identical title screen.
works: P1 Touch mode + hygiene. Phones/tablets start in touch mode (coarse pointer and no fine pointer, or coarse plus a mobile UA incl. iPadOS); it switches to desktop on real mouse movement/clicks or game keys and back on touch (hybrid test: mouse moved -> touch=false, desktop wording, FOV 70; touch again -> true). No pointer lock is requested on touch (player.isLocked false, dragMode false). Viewport meta: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover. Blocked: canvas touch-action, compat mouse events, iOS gesture* pinch, long-press menu, double-tap and page bounce; scrolling is still allowed in title/pause/inspect text/inputs. All HUD elements use env(safe-area-inset-*). Evidence: shots/t1-title-iphoneL.png, shots/t1-title-iphoneP.png. Audio: with autoplay restrictions ON, a CDP touch tap on '點擊開始交接' gave AudioContext state 'running'.

P2 Look + move. Drag anywhere that is not a control to look, same direction as a mouse (mobile FPS convention). Gain is 1.25 x vertical FOV / viewport height x the settings sensitivity; applied directly, no inertia; uses the same pitch clamps and blocking rules via PlayerController.lookBy. Floating analog joystick: appears where the thumb lands in the left 40% (portrait: left half, lower half); radius 40-64 px, 20% dead zone, base follows the finger past 1.5R, low-contrast ring, faint ghost ring when you can move. Shown only when PlayerController.canMove() (not in cutscenes, inspect, pause, title or menus). While seated, pushing the stick stands you up exactly like WASD. Multi-touch stick + look works at the same time. Measured: 120 px drag = 0.47 rad yaw; joystick moved the player 2.0-2.3 m and stood them up; a second finger rotated the view during the move. Evidence: shots/t2-joystick-iphoneL.png, shots/t5-corridor-seL.png (corridor walk x 8 -> 10.45 m with flashlight), shots/t5-corridor-rotated-seP.png.

P3 Interact. Tap = touch moved < 10 px and shorter than 450 ms (event timestamps). It raycasts from the tap point with tolerance rings at 12 px and 24 px; works on any interactable within its range, and the current gaze target gets +0.5 m slack. Drags never interact. Tapping CAM-02 switched channel 3 -> 2. The bottom prompt becomes a 44 px bordered button '[點擊] 檢視 黃色便利貼' (key cap from SCRIPT.touch.tapKey); tapping it opened the inspect view. UI controls swallow their own touches (canvas never sees them). Evidence: shots/t3-prompt-iphoneL.png, shots/t4-hud-iphoneL.png, shots/t4-hud-seP.png.

P4 Inspect / pause / title / end. Inspect: a 44 px ✕ closes it; drag rotates the 3D object, not the camera (object yaw 0 -> 0.44, player yaw unchanged); tapping outside the panel closes it, same as desktop left-click; text scrolls by finger (logbook scrollTop 0 -> 64) with the existing scroll cue worded '上下滑動'. Pause button: top-right, 48 px, safe-area aware; opens the existing pause panel, which scrolls on 375x667 and 667x375 (scrollTop 0 -> 51 in landscape); volume slider dragged by touch 0.8 -> 0.27; tapping empty space resumes. Title on touch shows the touch controls bar (拖曳 環顧 / 搖桿 移動 / 點擊 互動 / ⏸ 暫停, pause glyph drawn in CSS), tips instead of 'use a desktop', '視角靈敏度' as the slider label, and scrolls on 667x375. Start tries fullscreen + landscape lock inside the gesture and fails silently. End-choice buttons are 48 px tall and work by tap; the pause button is hidden during menus. Evidence: shots/t3-inspect-iphoneL.png, shots/t3-inspect-seP.png, shots/t9-logbook-seL.png, shots/t9-logbook-iphoneL.png, shots/t3-pause-iphoneL.png, shots/t3-pause-seP.png, shots/t8-pause-seL.png, shots/t8-title-scrolled-seL.png, shots/t4-end-seP.png.

P5 Orientation and layout. In portrait on touch, vertical FOV widens so horizontal FOV is at least about 62 degrees (vertical capped at 100; e.g. 91.3 at 390x664, 93.8 at 375x667, 100 at 390x844). The aspect ratio is never stretched; the CRT and all 4 CAM buttons stay on screen. Landscape and desktop keep FOV 70. Rotating at runtime re-applies FOV and pixel ratio (setViewportSize 667x375 -> 375x667 gave fov 93.8 and a 468x833 canvas); orientationchange re-applies again after 300 ms. In portrait the hint sits below the objective; subtitles clear the prompt button. Checked sizes: 375x667, 390x664, 390x844, 844x390, 863x360 (Pixel 7 landscape), 667x375, iPad 1024x768. Evidence: shots/t3-base-seP.png, shots/t5-room-iphoneP-390x844.png, shots/t5-room-ipadL.png, shots/t5-room-pixel7L.png, shots/t2-base-iphoneL.png, shots/t4-hud-iphoneL.png.

P6 Mobile quality preset (ctx.quality, mobile tier only). Measured at 844x390 DPR 3: canvas 1266x585 (desktop tier) -> 1055x487 (mobile, pixel-ratio cap 1.25); CCTV render targets 640x480 with 4x MSAA -> 480x360 without MSAA; shadow filter PCFSoft -> PCF; ash 800 -> 480, dust 320 -> 200, smoke 52 -> 40; resolution governor thresholds 21.5/18.5 ms -> 27.8/19.2 ms. Same programs (89), textures (188), geometries (438), unchanged light count. SwiftShader precompile 6.5 s -> 5.1 s. Desktop tier applies nothing (A/B identical).

Desktop regression: node scripts/build.mjs --out dist/blind-spot.html && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs passes all 6 states, both before and after the last change; dist/ restored afterwards. A/B evidence: shots/t6-desk-title-new.png vs shots/t6-desk-title-base.png, plus the matching config dump.
left: Real-device testing (iOS Safari, Android Chrome) and real mobile GPU frame-rate measurements; only SwiftShader emulation was available.
Docs (ARCHITECTURE.md / DESIGN-NOTES.md / README) were not edited because pacing-int owns them; see docNotes for text to merge.
No 'brisk' (Shift) speed on touch: the joystick tops out at walking speed, by design.
Optional later: a one-time '建議橫向持握' hint at game start in portrait (the title tips already say it).
scriptKeys: One new block at the END of SCRIPT in src/data/script.js, all 【補充文案】: SCRIPT.touch = { controls: '拖曳：環顧　搖桿：移動　點擊：互動　⏸︎：暫停', notice: ['建議戴上耳機、橫向持握。', 'iPhone 請先關閉側邊的靜音開關，否則聽不到聲音。'], sensitivity: '視角靈敏度', tapKey: '點擊', pause: '暫停' (pause button aria-label), close: '關閉' (✕ aria-label), hints: { look: '拖曳畫面環顧四周', move: '左側拇指拖曳移動　點擊物件互動', pointerLockFallback: '拖曳畫面環顧四周', closeInspect: '點 ✕ 或畫面空白處關閉', scrollInspect: '上下滑動' } }. The hard-coded TOUCH_NOTICE constant in UI.js was removed and replaced by SCRIPT.touch.notice. UI.hint() swaps hints.look / move / pointerLockFallback for the touch versions in touch mode, so PrologueState needed no edits.
hooksOutsideArea: None of the files pacing-int touches were edited except one append: src/data/script.js got the SCRIPT.touch block at the very end of SCRIPT. ControlRoom.js, CameraFeeds/feeds/*, MonitoringState, common.js and docs are untouched. Runtime coupling, applied post-construction from src/core/quality.js and only on the mobile tier: (a) ctx.feeds.renderTargets get samples=0, setSize x0.75, then dispose(); (b) ctx.controlRoom.smoke.parts.length is cut to 40 while no smoke is alive; (c) scene objects named 'ash' and 'dustMotes' get geometry.setDrawRange(0, N); (d) shadow mapSize is capped at 512 (currently a no-op). If pacing-int renames those objects or fields, the caps quietly do nothing; they are guarded and never throw. Other files changed (mine, additive): src/main.js (InputMode before UI, quality/governor options, rendererQuality, TouchControls construct/init/update before player, applyQuality before precompile, camera.fov = touchControls.fovFor(w,h) in applySize, orientationchange plus input:mode trigger a resize), src/index.html (viewport meta + theme-color), src/core/resolution.js (optional {cap, slowDt, fastDt}), PlayerController (analog, lookBy, canMove, no pointer lock on touch, re-lock on first canvas click after touch->mouse), Interaction (tapAt, useCurrent, _pick(ndc, slack); _use returns a boolean), InspectView (✕ button hidden by default, nudge(), syncHints(), ignores mousedown on .bs-tc elements), UI (touch/desk controls lines, CSS pause glyph, touch notice element, sensitivity label swap, prompt key swap + click handler, hint swap, menuVisible(), enterImmersive call in the title click).
qualityKnobs: src/core/quality.js detectQuality(params) returns {tier:'desktop'} (nothing changes) or the mobile preset: pixelRatioCap 1.25 (desktop 1.5; adaptive governor still steps down to x0.6); governor {slowDt 1/36 s, fastDt 1/52 s}, so it only drops resolution below about 36 fps and raises it above about 52 fps; shadowType 'PCF' (desktop PCFSoft; set before precompile); shadowMax 512 (all shadow-casting lights are already 512); composerSamples 2 (same as desktop; MSAA resolve is cheap on tile GPUs; set to 0 to disable); feedSamples 0 (desktop 4); feedScale 0.75 (CCTV render targets 640x480 -> 480x360; the CRT shader still uses 640x480 feedRes); ashCount 480/800, dustCount 200/320, smokeCount 40/52. Force with ?quality=mobile|desktop and ?touch=1|0. Light count and scene content are unchanged. First-frame stalls: the existing precompile/warm path is untouched, and applyQuality runs before it so render targets are allocated once at their final size. Test-only: ?tapms=N widens the tap time window (SwiftShader + CDP deliver each touch event about one frame late).
limitations: iOS silent switch mutes Web Audio and cannot be detected; the title tip tells players to turn it off. iPhone Safari has no Fullscreen API and no orientation lock (iPad has fullscreen only), so enterImmersive silently does nothing there; Chromium emulation reported fullscreen=true, but a real iPhone will not. iOS Safari before 13 has no Pointer Events, so touch controls need iOS 13+. The mobile preset is a reasoned guess: frame rates on real phones were not measured (SwiftShader runs at 0-4 fps here; numbers come from renderer.info and render-target sizes). Portrait on very tall phones (390x844) hits the 100 degree vertical FOV cap, giving some perspective stretch at top and bottom, and CAM-01/04 sit at the screen edges (still visible and tappable). The faint ghost joystick ring overlaps the CAM-01 area in portrait (visual only; taps still interact). On hybrid devices (keyboard + touch) the UI wording flips with the last input type, and leaving touch mode in portrait resets FOV to 70. user-scalable=no blocks page zoom (needed for the game; accessibility trade-off). Tapping outside the inspect panel closes it, same as desktop left-click (non-destructive; the item can be reopened). Pause is allowed while inspecting. Automated touch tests needed ?tapms because the harness acknowledges each touch event per frame.
docNotes: ARCHITECTURE.md §2 directory: add core/input.js (InputMode, looksLikeTouchDevice), core/quality.js (detectQuality / applyQuality / rendererQuality), systems/TouchControls.js. §4 ctx: ctx.input {touch, everTouch, set(bool)}, ctx.quality {tier, ...knobs}, ctx.touchControls {fovFor(w,h), enterImmersive(), update()}. §5 events: 'input:mode' {touch} (emitted synchronously inside the triggering input event). Module API additions: PlayerController.analog {x right, z back, length 0..1}, lookBy(dYaw, dPitch), canMove(); Interaction.tapAt(clientX, clientY) -> bool, useCurrent() -> bool; InspectView.nudge(dx, dy), syncHints(); UI.menuVisible(). Rule: every touch-only style is scoped under html.bs-touch, so desktop looks the same; new touch copy lives in SCRIPT.touch. §3 golden rules still hold: no haptics, all touch UI fades take at least 0.4 s, light count unchanged. §9 testing: params ?touch=1|0, ?quality=mobile|desktop, ?tapms=N; Playwright devices['iPhone 13'] etc. with CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent for drags and multi-touch. page.evaluate(() => BS.inspect.open(...)) hangs because open() resolves only on close, so wrap it in a block. Note: `git checkout -- dist index.html` silently does nothing when root index.html does not exist; use `git checkout -- dist`. DESIGN-NOTES: touch look follows mouse direction (mobile FPS convention) at 1.25 x vertical FOV per viewport height; joystick only appears when movement is possible; tap = < 10 px and < 450 ms with 12/24 px tolerance rings; portrait widens vertical FOV to keep horizontal FOV >= 62 degrees (cap 100); title tips (headphones, landscape, iPhone silent switch). README: add a 'Phones/tablets' section: landscape recommended, iPhone silent switch must be off, controls = drag to look / left-thumb joystick / tap objects or the bottom button / ⏸ top-right.
